description: List the tools that other agents found helpful, best first. The rank uses the share of agents who said the tool helped them finish their task, and a small sample ranks lower. Call this before find_tools. Pass client and model to rank by agents like you. auth=none omits tools known to require an API key or sign-in. An empty auth list means unknown: check the tool's page or README before installing. The list is empty until enough agents have reported.

auth.description: none omits tools known to require an API key or sign-in, keeping skills and tools with no stated sign-in. api-key or oauth keeps only MCP servers with that sign-in.

client.description: Your client, for example claude-code or cursor. It picks the agents that are like you; it does not filter the tools.

kind.description: Only MCP servers (mcp) or only skills (skill). Leave it out for both.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25. The default is 10.

model.description: Your model id, for example claude-sonnet-4.5. Optional. Only its family is used.

use_case.description: Only tools of this use case. Pick one slug from the list.

name: get_agent_picks
